bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a fire station in the city of Cass Lake; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CASS LAKE; FIRE STATION. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$10,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Cass Lake to construct, furnish, and equip a new fire station facility to replace the existing fire hall. The new facility will include living and administration space, vehicle and equipment storage, and a decontamination area to improve firefighter health and safety. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $10,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a fire station in the city of Cass Lake; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CASS LAKE; FIRE STATION.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$10,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Cass Lake to construct, furnish, and equip a new fire station facility to replace the existing fire hall. The new facility will include living and administration space, vehicle and equipment storage, and a decontamination area to improve firefighter health and safety.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $10,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $10,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Cass Lake to construct, furnish, and equip a new fire station facility to replace the existing fire hall. The new facility will include living and administration space, vehicle and equipment storage, and a decontamination area to improve firefighter health and safety.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $10,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
